scope: Generic DDS Stage A gate-diagnostic design; not Hugging Face-specific and not a Stage B/C result.
predecessor_policy: v0.1 draft and historical Stage A/HF artefacts are preserved; this manifest freezes only the v0.2 audit-candidate successor package.
acceptance_safeguards: Applicability and required_for_profile are frozen before adjudication.
Every DISCRIMINATING gate requires at least one preregistered fail-capable case.
Conditional named-claim dependencies must be machine-evaluable from frozen profile facts.
No Stage B handoff or remediation recommendation grants Stage A credit.
A coverage-only profile cannot be reported as a discriminating PASS.

known_regression.intended_result: SA-G04 may remain PASS while CLAIM-AUTHORITY-RESOLVED is CONDITIONAL_ON(SA-G03); required-profile outcome is therefore PROFILE_PARTIAL rather than PROFILE_PASS when SA-G03 is unresolved.

evidence_ceiling: Design/structural freeze. No independent reviewer agreement, real candidate adjudication, Stage B verification or Stage C implementation validation is claimed.
